title: SUDI
summary: Marketplace backend where listings, payments, users and live chat work together under load, secured end to end.
problem: A marketplace needs listings, payments, user management and live chat to work together under load, and to stay secure while doing it.
approach: A REST API on the PERN stack with authentication enforced at every endpoint, a schema tuned for the real query patterns, and a real-time channel alongside it for chat and notifications.
highlights: Built the REST API layer covering users, listings, payments and chat.
OAuth2 and JWT enforced on every endpoint.
Designed and optimised the PostgreSQL schema to bring query times down.
Caching and performance tuning for high-activity periods.
Unit and integration tests with Jest; automated CI/CD pipeline.

outcome.label: Result
outcome.value: Measurably faster queries under real user load
